entry.title: Resolution 497 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): — → Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN INTERGOVERNMENTAL AGREEMENT WITH THE UNITED STATES DEPARTMENT OF HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT TO RECEIVE GRANTS FOR ACTIVITIES AND PROJECTS IN THE 2026 ANNUAL ACTION PLAN TO BE USED BY THE OFFICE OF HOUSING AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT

Allows for the receipt of $2,970,000 in federally derived funds to be used for activities and projects in the 2026 Annual Action Plan.

Status: — → Adopted

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 497-26 & GOEAC-114 - 04/22/26
